stage1.impression: A clean, centred studio sweep with a red tinted-acrylic horn speaker. The object reads, but the frame still reads as CG. The seamless is a dull, slightly green mid-grey, not a luminous pale backdrop. The speaker barely touches the floor: no dense contact shadow, and only a faint, streaky reflection. The horn carries a blown, plastic-looking highlight, the cabinet's right face goes muddy maroon, and the edges are soft from denoising.

blocking_9: Seamless reads as a pale warm grey: top-left lum_median 195-215 and delta_e to #D9D5CF under 6 (now 170, delta_e 11.2, green cast with g > r)
A dense, dark contact line where the cabinet meets the floor, plus a soft reflection that holds together under the base, so the object has weight
The cabinet's right face reads as lit red acrylic with a traced edge highlight, not a muddy maroon slab
No clipped plastic-looking highlight on the horn; its gloss reads as polished cast acrylic
Crisp silhouette edges at final resolution (10-90 edge width of 6 px or less on the cabinet's right edge in the proof)
The busy internal structure seen through the acrylic needs a decision outside this shot (see out_of_scope)

defects.what: Backdrop is mid-grey (lum ~170-178) with a green tint (RGB 171,173,165), off-spec from #D9D5CF; reads dull and murky, not pale warm grey
Left half of the backdrop is ~35 lum darker than the right (172 vs 208): lopsided and dingy behind the key side
Almost no contact shadow under the base (lum_median 237.6 right under the cabinet); the speaker looks set down, not standing
Floor reflection is a faint, broken set of red vertical streaks; it neither commits to a reflection nor disappears
Cabinet's right face is murky maroon (lum_median 62, R 119 / G 47): no light passes through, no edge highlight
Horn front has a large blown white reflection blob on the left (0.68% clip) next to near-black (4.9% crush): reads as glossy toy plastic
Soft silhouette edge (10-90 width 13 px): denoise smear, CG softness
Internal bracing, port rings, crossover block and panel slots seen through the acrylic make a busy, cluttered read
The vent slot at the top right reads as a grey hole with a small hot red specular; a distracting detail

changes.problem: The seamless is too dark and green-grey for an Apple-style pale warm-grey launch frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 169.9, RGB 169/171/163, delta_e2000 11.23 vs #D9D5CF; whole-frame top band 170-179

change.to: 0.9; 1.0; shift one step toward magenta (about 0.03, in whichever sign removes the green so that r_median >= g_median)

changes.expected: Backdrop lifts to lum 200-215 at the top and reads warm-neutral (R >= G > B), with the bottom of the floor still just under clipping.

changes.problem: The speaker has no weight: there is no dense contact shadow under the cabinet.

evidence.measured: lum_median 237.6, p5 233.5: the floor directly under the base is nearly as bright as open floor

changes.expected: A thin, dark occlusion line along the front base edge, falling into a soft 5-8 cm penumbra.

changes.problem: The cabinet's right face is a muddy maroon slab; the acrylic does not glow and the edge is not traced.
changes.expected: The right face lifts to a translucent mid red, with a continuous thin highlight running down the rear vertical edge.

changes.problem: The horn carries a clipped white reflection blob that reads as toy plastic, against crushed black.
changes.expected: The horn's gloss becomes a graded highlight that shows its curvature, without a hard white patch; the mouth stays dark but not void-black.

changes.problem: The floor reflection is faint, broken streaks that read as an artefact rather than a glossy floor.

evidence.measured: lum_median 232.6 with p5 204.9; visually only scattered red vertical streaks under the base

changes.expected: A coherent, softly blurred red reflection of the cabinet's base that fades out within about 15% of its height.

changes.problem: The backdrop behind the key side is much darker than behind the fill side, so the frame looks lopsided and the left silhouette lacks separation.
changes.expected: A soft pool of light on the sweep behind the speaker, biased left, so the left and right backdrops are within 15 lum and the silhouette separates.

changes.problem: The silhouette and internal edges are smeared by denoising, so the object looks rendered, not photographed.

evidence.measured: cabinet right edge step 138.8, 10-90 width 13 px

changes.expected: Crisp acrylic edges and slot details; edge width halves.

out_of_scope.request: Simplify or hide the internal bracing, port rings, crossover block and panel slots visible through the cabinet
out_of_scope.why: They are the speaker's parts and the acrylic's tint; the clutter they make through the clear sides is the biggest thing holding the frame below 8, but the shot may not change them.

out_of_scope.request: Make the vent slot at the cabinet's top right less of a grey hole
out_of_scope.why: It is part of the cabinet's geometry.
